image_description: Three handheld media players (iPods) held in a human hand against a textured grey fabric background. The leftmost device is silver with a visible screen and click wheel; the middle is black with a similar layout; the rightmost is partially obscured but appears to be a black iPod Touch or similar touchscreen model. The screens display menu interfaces with text and album art.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the screens is illegible and distorted. While it mimics the layout of lines and blocks, individual characters are malformed or nonsensical, a common AI artifact in rendering small text.

artifact_observations.location: Click wheel of the leftmost (silver) iPod
artifact_observations.reasoning: The icons/text on the click wheel are slightly blurred and lack the crispness of real printed labels. The 'Menu' and play symbols are recognizable but soft and slightly warped.

artifact_observations.location: Right edge of the rightmost device and fingers holding it
artifact_observations.reasoning: The boundary between the rightmost device and the fingers holding it is slightly muddy. The fingers appear to merge slightly with the device casing, lacking clear occlusion boundaries.

artifact_observations.location: Overall geometry of the three devices
artifact_observations.reasoning: The devices are not perfectly parallel or aligned in a physically rigid way; they seem to float slightly relative to each other, though this could be due to hand movement. The perspective lines on the screens don't perfectly match the device bezels.
